landing.heroSub: Open the browser. Find a video. Call your friends. That's it.

faqItems.q: How to watch videos together online with friends?
faqItems.a: Download WeWatch, open the built-in browser, find a video on YouTube, VK or Rutube, create a room and send the link to a friend. Everyone sees the same frame in real time.
Yes, WeWatch is completely free. Download it from the App Store or Google Play and start watching with friends right away — sign up with your phone number.

faqItems.q: Can I watch YouTube with friends at the same time?
faqItems.a: Yes. WeWatch supports YouTube, VK Video, Rutube, Uzmove and any other site through the built-in browser. Pause and seek work for everyone at once.

faqItems.q: What if my friend is far away?
faqItems.a: Create a Watch Party in WeWatch, invite your friend with a link — and you watch in sync as if sitting side by side. Distance doesn't matter.

faqItems.q: Can we watch if one is on the phone and the other on the site?
faqItems.a: Yes — WeWatch syncs playback across all platforms at once. iPhone, Android and a desktop browser work in one room without limits.

faqItems.q: How to watch videos together for free?
faqItems.a: WeWatch is a free app to watch videos together online. Create a room, share the link — and watch YouTube, VK, Rutube in sync with friends.

faqItems.q: Can we watch anime or series together?
faqItems.a: Yes, WeWatch works with any video site through the built-in browser — including anime and series sites. Just open the site and create a room.
